evals.prompt: I have a small TypeScript service and only need PORT and DATABASE_URL. Should I parse env directly or build a config object first?
evals.expected_output: Recommends the simple env-first path and points to the relevant rule.

evals.prompt: My notifications feature only needs a queue URL when NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED is true. How should I model and validate this config?
evals.expected_output: Recommends config-first validation and explains why the flag changes the boundary.

evals.prompt: Our app stores TLS cert paths and secret ARNs in config. Should we check those resources while parsing config?
evals.expected_output: Separates shape parsing from later verification of external resources.

evals.prompt: We have a retry default in both the schema and the factory. Which one should own it?
evals.expected_output: Pushes toward a single owner for the default and explains why duplicated defaults drift.

evals.prompt: This module only needs one SNS topic value, but it currently imports a giant app config object. What should we change?
evals.expected_output: Moves the module toward a smaller validated config slice instead of a giant shared config bag.
